response.query: Beyond MMD/FID and zero-shot success, which early sim-to-real proxies (e.g., linear-probe gap, encoder-proprio mutual info, ensemble epistemic gap) best predict fine-tune gains with 500–2000 real episodes?
response.answer: Ensemble epistemic gap and mutual information between encoder and proprioceptive features best predict fine-tune gains with 500–2000 real episodes. These metrics capture model uncertainty and sensor alignment, crucial for sim-to-real transfer.
